_comment: intraday_app: many hedged trades a day. Do stocks that stray from their sector fund within the day come back (fade) or keep going (ride), better than random stocks, after costs? On 1-minute bars, with the same development / validation / holdout years and pass marks as config/morning.json. Rules are fixed here BEFORE the first run (2026-11-15); nothing is tuned by it.
_universe_comment: Each month, from the formation_days of daily bars before it: the `stocks` with the most dollar volume, priced above min_price, with a bar every day, that move less closely than max_correlation with SPY, every fund and every stock already picked (so no index, sector or leveraged funds, and one share class per company), and aren't in not_stocks. Each is hedged in the fund it moved with most, at its beta to it. Daily bars are shared with pairs_app (data/pairs/daily); only stocks averaging load_dollar_volume over all their bars are loaded.
_day_comment: Minutes after the 09:30 open: looks every step_minutes from first_minute, enters until last_entry_minute (15:30), and sells whatever's left at 15:59's close.
_signal_comment: The gap: the stock's move over lookback_minutes less beta x its fund's, divided by its usual size for that long (the daily standard deviation of that difference over the formation year x sqrt(lookback / 390)). Trade it at |z| >= entry_z, biggest first, up to stocks_each_side a side; out when it's back to exit_z (closed), after hold_minutes, or at the close.
_money_comment: Each stock is leverage x equity / (2 x stocks_each_side); hedged, the book holds -beta x that in its fund, trading only the funds' net change each step. Orders fill at the open of the minute delay_minutes after the signal. Costs as everywhere else: slippage_percent against us on each fill, regulatory fees on every sale (short sales too). Borrowing costs aren't counted.
_variants_comment: The control for each: on each step as many entries a side as its signals made, of random stocks from the month's list, each held as long as the trade it copies, hedged the same way.
